method: Summon • Demon Parade • Wanted Quests • Dispatch

skills.name: Vortex Assault (风袭/風の襲撃)
skills.description: Ootengu shapes the wind into a vortex to assault a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK.

skills.name: Wings of Steel (钢铁之羽/鋼鉄の羽)
skills.line: Behold my mighty wings - and perish!
skills.description:
At the start of battle and at the end of Ootengu's turns, he gains Shelter. At the start of his turn, Shelter is lost.
When dealing damage, he has a 50% chance of gaining Heroic Posture, max of 10 stacks. The effect lasts until the end of the round. ;Heroic Posture (勇気凛々) : :'''General, Mark''': Each layer increases his damage dealt by 1%. ;Shelter :Blocks all control effects, or Banish and similar effects, from a single skill. Includes self-inflicted control effects. :''(Shelter is represented by a swirling vortex of feathers underneath Ootengu.)''

upgrades.text: Max Heroic Posture stacks increases to 30.
Max Heroic Posture stacks increases to 50.
Max Heroic Posture stacks increases to 80.
After Shelter blocks a control effect, uses Blade Storm at no cost.

skills.name: Blade Storm (羽刃暴风/刃羽の嵐)
skills.line: The power of the wind shall be engraved into your flesh!
skills.description: Ootengu commands a storm to rain blades onto all enemies to inflict 4 continuous strikes, dealing damage equal to 65% of his ATK with each strike. For each enemy hit, gains 1 stack of Heroic Posture and increases his move bar by 5%. ;Heroic Posture (勇気凛々) : :'''General, Mark''': Each layer increases his damage dealt by 1%.

bio.condition: With Ootengu win 5 times in PVN zones against Arakawa no Aruji.
With Ootengu clear stage 9 of the Orochi soul zone (solo).
